cli.config_unset: {key} removed: the default value applies again.
cli.llm_default: {keys}: using the default value (Hermes keeps no explicit copy of a default).
cli.llm_no_fallback: no fallback chain: if the provider fails (no credit, rate limit), analysis retries later. Add one: hermes meeting-scribe llm fallback add <provider>:<model>
cli.llm_unavailable: Hermes' configuration is not available in this runtime.
cli.meet_channel_missing: ⚠️ Google Meet import is on but no notes channel is set: notes go to the server's system channel or a channel named like delivery_auto_channel_names (#general, #meetings…); if none exists they wait. Set google_meet_discord_channel (a channel name or id) to choose one.

cli.setup_tasks_placement: Where the tasks go — meeting: everything in one place with the notes (recommended, less noise); projects: each task in a thread of its project's channel; projects_inline: straight in the project's channel. Assignees get their DM in every case.
cli.waiting_retried: {count} delivery(ies) waiting for a channel will be retried now by the gateway.
cmd.capture_unavailable: Live recording isn't available in this installation. You can still browse, search and reprocess meetings.
cmd.error: The command could not be completed. Try again in a moment and, if it keeps failing, tell an administrator.
cmd.help:
**/{cmd}** — meeting notes
`start [#voice]` start recording · `stop` stop recording · `status` what's going on · `list [n]` latest meetings · `show <id>` a meeting's notes · `search <text>` search what was said · `reprocess <id> [from=transcribe|analyze|deliver]` redo a meeting (from the audio, only the notes, or only post them again) · `link @user <Linear email or name>` (yourself; owners: anyone, or `google=users/<id>` for a Google Meet attendee) · `project <id> <project>` · `config` settings · `help` · in a private message, with several teams: add `space=<id>`
cmd.link_owner_only: Only the plugin's owners can link another member or a Google account. You can link yourself to Linear: `/meeting link @you <Linear email or name>`.
cmd.link_google_saved: Linked <@{discord_id}> to the Google account {account}: they now get the Google Meet meetings they attend.
cmd.project_saved: Meeting `{id}` assigned to project “{project}”; future meetings in this channel will use that project.
cmd.project_unknown: I don't know the project “{project}”. Available: {candidates}
cmd.reprocess_bad_stage: I don't recognise `{stage}`. Use `from=transcribe` (start again from the audio), `from=analyze` (regenerate the notes) or `from=deliver` (post the notes again).
cmd.reprocess_dm_how: The notes of this meeting were posted in a direct message. Use `from=deliver` to move them to the notes channel.
cmd.reprocess_dm_moving: The notes of this meeting were posted in a direct message; they will be moved to the notes channel if an administrator has chosen one.
cmd.reprocess_empty: Meeting `{id}` has no audio (nobody was heard), so there is nothing to reprocess.
cmd.reprocess_no_audio: This meeting was imported without audio: its notes will be regenerated from its transcript.
cmd.reprocess_queued: Meeting `{id}`: {stage}. The notes will be updated when it's done.
cmd.status_failed_extra: — couldn't finish ({stage}). Try `reprocess`, or ask an administrator to check `hermes meeting-scribe status`.
cmd.status_idle: Not recording right now. Meetings waiting to be processed: {queued}.
cmd.status_orphan: `{id}` is marked as recording, but the process capturing it is gone: the gateway closes and processes it when it starts.
cmd.status_recording: Recording now: {meetings}. Meetings waiting to be processed: {queued}.
cmd.status_waiting_channel: — waiting for a channel to post the notes in; an administrator needs to choose one.
doctor.llm_no_fallback: no fallback chain for meeting analysis: add one with `hermes meeting-scribe llm fallback add <provider>:<model>`
google.connect_intro: Open this URL in a browser signed in to your Google Workspace account and grant read access to Meet:
google.connect_paste: After consenting, paste the full URL of the page you were redirected to (it may fail to load; that is fine) or just the code:

google.connected: ✅ Google connected. New Meet transcripts ending after now will be imported{extra}.
google.enable_hint: once you run `hermes meeting-scribe config set google_meet_enabled true` (and restart the gateway)
google.no_client: Google: no OAuth client stored. Pass --client-secret <file.json> (Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth client, type Desktop app).
google.not_connected: Google: not connected. Run `hermes meeting-scribe google connect --client-secret <file.json>`.
google.reconnected: ✅ Google reconnected. Meet transcripts ending after the first connection ({since}, at most 30 days back) that are not imported yet will be imported{extra}.
google.revoke_failed: ⚠️ Could not revoke the access at Google (network or Google error). The local token is deleted, but the grant may still be active: remove it at {url}
google.status_connected: Google: connected (scope meetings.space.readonly; the account is not read).
google.status_disconnected: Google: disconnected — access was revoked or expired. Run `hermes meeting-scribe google connect` again.
google.sync_report: Listed {listed} conference(s): {imported} imported, {already} already imported, {pending} transcript(s) not ready yet, {none} without transcript.

cfg.delivery_forum_tags.label: Forum post tags
cfg.delivery_forum_tags.help: When notes or tasks go to a forum channel, also apply the forum tags with these names to each meeting post (the tag matching the meeting's project is applied anyway). Max 5 per post; names the forum does not have are ignored.
cfg.delivery_forum_default_tag.label: Default forum tag
cfg.delivery_forum_default_tag.help: For forums that require a tag on every post: the tag to use when no tag matches the project or the forum post tags (the first name that exists in that forum). Empty = none; the post then waits until a tag is set.
ui.error_forum_needs_tag: That forum requires a tag on every post and none of its tags matches this project. Ask an admin to set `delivery_forum_default_tag`, or pick another channel.
cfg.meeting_routes.label: Notes channel per meeting
cfg.meeting_routes.help: Where the notes of some meetings go, one rule per line: 'origin = #channel'. Origin: a voice channel (name or id), 'category:<name>' for every voice channel of a Discord category, or 'meet:<code>' for Google Meet (* and ? allowed). Add ':private' to keep everything in that channel: tasks are shared with people or project channels only when someone there presses a button. Example: 'Leadership = #leadership-notes:private'.
share.not_shared: Only visible here. Nothing has been shared yet.
share.index_private: Private meeting: nothing leaves this channel unless someone here shares it.
share.moved_private: ↪️ This task is no longer shown here.
share.only_in_private: This meeting is private: use the buttons in its own channel.
share.not_member: Only people who can see this channel can decide what is shared.
share.error_dm: I couldn't send it: that person doesn't accept direct messages from the bot.
share.not_private: This meeting is not private any more; these buttons no longer apply.
share.confirm_all: Share every open task? Each one is sent to its assignee and published in its project channel. The summary stays here.
share.done_all: Done: {dms} sent to people, {channels} published in project channels.
